reasons.summary: bump gRPC and x/net to close Dependabot CVEs
scope the safehttp private-IP SSRF bypass to specific hostnames (#71)
safehttp.IsBlocked refuses NAT64 and 6to4 addresses that carry a blocked IPv4 address, and jsbundle's default client is SSRF-guarded; the first tagged release with it is v0.103.0 (#174)

min_safe_unchanged.reason: Latent: PublicPathPrefixes is opt-in and exists only from v0.104.1, and behind http.ServeMux, which server.New uses, the paths that skipped the gate are redirected, so the hole was reachable only behind a router that cleans paths before routing. The only service known to declare a prefix routes on Server.Mux. A service without a prefix has nothing to exempt, and one older than v0.104.1 has no such option. Raising the floor to v0.107.0 would report every service below it for a hole none of them can be hit by.

note: A version below min_safe lacks a security fix that go-common itself shipped. At or above it no such fix is outstanding, but advisories in go-common's dependencies and in the Go toolchain are tracked separately (scripts/govulncheck-allow.txt).
